macos.expiry: $[entry].expires_at as iso8601; absent counts as 30 days from now
macos.notes: An object keyed '{issuer}::{client_id}', one entry per signed-in CLI. Trust only entries whose key starts with https://auth.x.ai or whose oidc_issuer is https://auth.x.ai; any other issuer is a customer IdP whose token is meant for a private proxy and must never reach the public endpoint. Prefer an unexpired trusted entry.

endpoints.name: billing
endpoints.notes: An expired credential throws before any request. 429 → flat 60 s, not persisted.

windows.label: {humanize(productUsage[0].product)} e.g. Grok Build
windows.notes: $.config must be an object or the response is bad. Fallback when creditUsagePercent is absent: one window per $.config.productUsage[*].usagePercent, the first forced to id 'credits' so the dial has its declared headline. No windows → nothingMetered.

sessions.macos: ~/.grok/active_sessions.json (array of {session_id, pid, opened_at, cwd}) and ~/.grok/sessions/<percent-encoded cwd>/<session_id>/updates.jsonl
sessions.notes: A row is live when its pid is alive (start time within 5 minutes of opened_at), its session directory is found (encoded cwd first, then a scan for the id), and updates.jsonl was written within 45 s. Many sessions allowed; never waiting.
